item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 04/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will remain cool over the coast of Guangdong this morning. With the easterly airstream moderating, the weather will be relatively humid over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. It will be warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas of southern China on Saturday. Winds will strengthen gradually and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region over the weekend. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, it will be cold in the morning and at night over inland areas early next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone now over the seas east of the Philippines will intensify gradually today and tomorrow, and move towards the vicinity of the central and southern parts of the Philippines.
